findPasskey calls matchCredentialId, which returns 'legacy' when stored === legacyEncoding(browserId), and credentialIdQuery asks for both forms, so legacy passkeys do match.
The diff adds tests/http/passkeys.test.js and a software authenticator that run the real register, sign-in and deletion ceremonies; the auth.test.js comment only points to that file.
After the first sign-in, the legacy test checks that `(await storedPasskeys(t.userId))[0].credentialID` equals authenticator.id, which is exactly the rewrite check.
A (1/4)^16 chance of a false match is negligible and documented as such; the test correctly guards against the check breaking, and the finding names no real defect.
